recipes.name: Lettuce Wraps & Mango Sticky Rice inspired by Spider-Man: Homecoming
instructions: In a dry skillet, pour in the Thai glutinous rice and dry roast for about 15-20 min over medium-low heat. Make sure to turn constantly, until they resemble grain. Remove from heat and allow to cool completely. - 2 cups Thai Glutinous Rice

Pulverize the cooled rice by using a high powered blender or a mortar and pestle. Grind until the granules are small enough to not get stuck in your teeth but large enough that they retain some crunch, resembling coarse sand.
Thinly slice the shallot and scallions. Finely chop the lemongrass. Wash and dry the mint and cilantro and remove the stems. - 1 small Shallot - 3 Scallions - Fresh Mint - Cilantro - Lemongrass

In a large skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium-high until shimmering. Add ground pork and brown. During the last minute of cooking, add the lemongrass and break down meat into bite sized pieces. Remove from heat. - 3 tbsp Vegetable Oil - 1 pound Ground Pork

In the large skillet with meat, add generous pinches of Thai chili powder, sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, shallot, scallions, whole mint leaves, and toasted rice powder. Taste and add salt if necessary. - 2 pinches Thai chili Powder - ⅓ tsp Sugar - ½ tbsp Fish Sauce - 1 Lime
Place seasoned meat over large lettuce leaves, add cilantro, and enjoy! - Large Lettuce Leaves
In a large bowl, combine sticky rice and water, then massage to break up any clumps. Cover and let sit at room temperature for at least 6 hours, up to 24. - 3 cups Sweet Sticky Rice - 4 cups Water
After sitting, uncover rice and strain it.
In a large pot, boil a few inches of water. Place strainer with rice over large pot and cover with the lid of the pan.
Let steam for 15 minutes and stir, then let cook again for an additional 15 minutes.
In a small saucepan pour in coconut milk. Heat to about 200°F and then add sugar. Take off heat and stir to combine. - 16 ounces Coconut Milk - ¾ cup Sugar
Put rice in large bowl, pour in half of coconut sauce, and stir. Let sit aside for about 20 minutes.
Peel the mango, cut around pit, then thinly slice. Spread decoratively on a plate. - 1 Mango
Place rice into a ramekin that is lined with plastic wrap and flip over onto plate. Top with a generous amount of coconut sauce, garnish with optional mint, and enjoy! - Mint Garnish (optional)
